rationale: Included depression families use sunflower oil with a small fish-oil admixture. The Australian registration planned a sunflower comparator. Review entries do not provide a separate oil effect or executive comparison.
Study groups shared injected tamoxifen in sunflower oil. Gait and nonmotor tests include a buried-food olfaction task and operant sensation seeking, with no separate dietary oil comparison.
